subtitle: THE LIVING COMMAND CENTER — Cinematic Homepage, Personal Chronicle & Adventure Board
changes: Introduced the v10 Living Command Center as the first-visit homepage while preserving the original full companion and its dedicated legacy Citadel and Living Azeroth entrances.

Created a distinctive HD 1600x900 Citadel hero, sovereign feature portrait, five illustrated chamber destinations using existing repository artwork, responsive interactive layouts and subtle optional snowfall.
Added browser-local character roster and saved build draft previews from established companion storage keys, clearly labeled as manual records and never claimed as verified game-account data.

Added a separately namespaced v10 Adventure Board with editable completion state, protected deletion, a 120-goal limit, and a downloadable JSON export; earlier companion tasks and collection plans remain read-only.
Added universal local command search (Ctrl/Cmd+K) covering existing studios, saved characters, build drafts, personal objectives and collection goals, with no new server requests.
Included recent companion view continuation, obvious links back to all original tools, and a dedicated Command Center shortcut inside the main application.
Preserved Cloudflare account verification, Blizzard research endpoints, existing talent allocations, collections, music, storage schema and user site branding. No new credentials or infrastructure.
Adapted controls, thumbnails and particles for desktop and iPhone, respecting reduced motion, low-power preferences and inactive browser tabs.
Created a non-destructive v9.4 rollback branch before changes; staging release requires real-device visual and player acceptance before public announcement.
Introduced the additive v9.4 luxury visual layer across the main companion, Citadel, Living Azeroth, Sovereign Ascension, Character Intelligence, Progression Intelligence, Oracle and Addon Nexus.

Preserved the existing five chamber illustrations and sharp HD Citadel panorama, with meaningful individual warm-gold, frost-blue, violet, adventure and oracle accents rather than generic replacement art.
Refined cinematic portrait cards, lighting, readability, keyboard focus preservation and desktop hover elevation without changing studio links, forms or player-facing functionality.

Introduced small contained scene-matched hero particles on external studios only (snow/frost, embers or arcane glow), automatically respecting reduced motion, data saver, low-memory devices and the existing performance preference.

Paused decorative particles on hidden tabs, reduced their counts on mobile and disabled costly mobile panel backdrop blur; kept the Citadel and Living Azeroth existing particle engines instead of stacking duplicates.

All improvements use existing locally hosted assets and independent CSS/JS, with a backup branch for rollback. No authentication, API, cloud Worker, music, Blizzard data, inventory or saved-data schema changes.
Refreshed the main companion and existing external studio panels with mostly opaque luminous-glass surfaces, brighter navy depth and refined gold/cyan edging.
Improved Loot Hunter, Armory, Talent Forge, progression, dashboards, collection records, metric tiles, forms and research cards with better contrast and interaction cues.
Enhanced selected navigation, keyboard focus visibility and gentle hover highlights without moving controls or introducing new animations or assets.
Reused the existing shared presentation stylesheet so no new CSS, JavaScript, API, account, music or saved-data dependencies were introduced.
Preserved full-bleed ZevRo panorama and Citadel illustrations with mobile, reduced-motion and performance-aware glass effects.

Replaced the undersized partial illustrations inside Talent Forge, Live Armory, research, journal, guide, Sovereign and addon feature banners with a consistent high-resolution 2172×724 panoramic ZevRo artwork.
Used CSS cover sizing, responsive positioning and accessible text gradients so wide panels are fully illustrated rather than showing a small portrait fragment.
Removed the small inset portrait from independent intelligence banners while preserving the existing unique five-chamber portal artwork.
Retained all authentication, Blizzard lookups, saved data, navigation, audio, Founder and developer tools; no JavaScript changes.
Replaced remaining legacy assassin-theme artwork in Talent Forge banners and illustrated guide/journal panels with matching original Citadel assets.
Added a contextual studio-art theme that changes with the active main application section, using existing hosted widescreen and portrait WebP artwork.
Illustrated Character Intelligence, Progression Intelligence, Sovereign Ascension, Azeroth Assistant, Addon Nexus, and alternate Living Azeroth without altering their gameplay research or forms.
Maintained responsive asset sizing, source-safe informational messaging, and existing authentication, build storage, music and performance controls.
Corrected blurry cinematic entrance imagery with a dedicated 1600 × 900 WebP landscape hero and framed chamber preview artwork.
Changed the five chamber destinations into a responsive portrait gallery, capped at the original 380px illustration width rather than stretching the portraits into landscape cards.
Improved first-view artwork loading and retained all studio links, user preferences, saved data, performance modes and account flows.
Added a self-contained Citadel Awakening gateway at the canonical site URL for fresh visits, with the app's heavy resources loading only after selecting the full companion.
Added five previewable chambers, searchable navigation, three locally pinned shortcuts and a recent-chamber launcher; all links open existing working studios.
Added optional distinct illustrated artwork for each chamber, falling back safely to existing hosted v9 artwork until installed.
Retained Cinematic, Balanced and Performance modes with reduced-motion respect, preserved all existing local save formats and Blizzard account controls.
Provided staged browser acceptance for the new gateway and protected the published Discord release index until verification.

Made Living Azeroth the canonical first-visit cinematic homepage, with premium artwork, five studio paths, and an Enter Companion action that safely reveals the original application; session-scoped dismissal and direct bypass avoid navigation loops.
Introduced Living Azeroth, a fully illustrated original cinematic entrance and five interactive destinations with adaptive fantasy presentation.
Built a reusable v9 visual engine with original SVG citadel and oracle artwork, atmospheric particles, source-aware visuals, and Cinematic/Balanced/Performance modes.
Enhanced the original Talent Forge with visual node selection, glowing allocated paths and a read-only selected-node inspector fed from existing Blizzard-reported talent text and rank controls.
Introduced a Living Armory presentation with selectable equipment slots and detail cards sourced strictly from existing Blizzard public equipment responses.
Added an Adventure Journal navigation and chapter styling around the existing Mythic+, raid and reputations research without inventing achievement or inventory records.
Transformed ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant into an illustrated Oracle persona with guided-response states while retaining the existing curated knowledge and Mission Architect.
Added cinematic styling and a five-chamber navigator to Sovereign Ascension, improved desktop/mobile responsiveness, opt-in performance settings and reduced-motion respect.
Preserved the v8.0 rollback branch, legacy saved-data formats, Battle.net Cloudflare Worker, existing original studios, Founder bubble and HYPER MUSIC without changing their logic.
Synchronized Player Handbook, Getting Started, developer test requests, QA device acceptance, Gateway and release notes; guarded Discord release draft remains staging until acceptance.
